summary: Keep the ERP notice and any registration error screenshot together. In one message, mention the course code, your batch and the date you tried to apply.
Before walking to an office, check whether the issue is permission to apply or an ERP error. That distinction helps you pick the right contact.
Ask for an explanation of one specific discrepancy first. A short note naming the assessment is easier for an instructor to act on.
Put the subject code and exam name in the email subject. Ask for the next script-viewing slot, then note the question numbers you want to discuss.
Write down what you think is wrong and where you spotted it. Keep a copy of your original message so you can follow up in the same thread.
Prepare a short list of affected class dates and courses before talking to your advisor. Ask which documents to share and where to submit them.
Keep the original subject line when following up. Put the decision you need and the deadline near the top of the message.
